posts.title: Know Your Contacts: Usable Authentication for Secure Messaging
posts.description: My master's thesis redesigns contact verification in end-to-end encrypted messengers like Signal. Users preferred it, but only automation got more contacts verified.

posts.title: Importing Snapchat Memories into an End-to-End Encrypted App
posts.description: Users switching from Snapchat to twonly want to take their Memories with them. I designed a protocol that lets a browser encrypt and upload thousands of memories into a user's end-to-end encrypted twonly Memories, without the browser ever receiving a key that could read, modify or delete anything else.

posts.title: Break my Passwordless Recovery Protocol and get a 50€ Bug-Bounty
posts.description: I designed a passwordless recovery protocol using trusted friends and a server-side second factor for my privacy-focused messaging app twonly. To ensure its security before release, I am launching a 50€ bug bounty challenge for anyone who can find a vulnerability in the protocol.
